title: Event Rental Benches & Picnic Tables
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ARGONNE NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Argonne National Laboratory is seeking quotations from qualified local/Chicagoland vendors for the rental, delivery, setup, and pickup of seating furniture for the Argonne Open House, scheduled to occur in June 2026 at Argonne National Laboratory. The selected vendor shall provide the following rental items: 54 Benches 18 Picnic Tables Offers will be due April 10th, by 12 noon, Central time. Send any inquiries to Luke Oprondek at loprondek@anl.gov. Thank you for your interest.
